items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: In fact, we met Fats Waller in Oakland.

ctx.x:
Okay.
How long were you on the coast?

Oh, we were on the coast about a month. We played up and down the coast.
Ella had to make a picture for a week.
Then we went in the Trianon Ballroom for about a week or two weeks.
Then we went up to the Golden Gate Theater in San Francisco. We played all the way up.
We played the Sweets -- (inaudible) place called the Sweets Ballroom. He had ballrooms like in California, Oakland -- right straight up.
We played about five or six of his ballrooms. In fact, we met Fats Waller in Oakland.
And my brother was there.
